summary.text: Raymond Petersen is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 56, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Erin Maye Quade (D).
Ballotpedia says he served in the U.S. Navy as an engineer and has worked designing life safety systems and driving trucks.

paragraphs.text: Raymond Petersen was born in Stillwater, Minnesota, and attended Stillwater Senior High School.
He served in the U.S. Navy as an engineer, and his career experience involves designing life safety systems and driving trucks.
Petersen also filed to run for U.S. Senate in Minnesota in 2026 but did not appear on the ballot for the August 11 Republican primary.
He advanced from the August 11 Republican primary for State Senate District 56.
